titleZh: 开展数据产权登记，助力数据要素价值释放
titleEn: Carrying Out Data Property Rights Registration to Release the Value of Data Elements
sumZh: 中国财政科学研究院研究员赵治纲解读《数据产权登记工作指引（试行）》，认为全国统一数据产权登记制度为数据权属认定提供权威方案，为数据资产入表提供确权依据，并建议修改资产定义推动数据全面资产化。
sumEn: Researcher Zhao Zhigang interprets the trial Data Property Rights Registration Guidelines, arguing the national unified registration system provides an authoritative solution for data ownership and a basis for on-balance-sheet data assets.

titleZh: 数据产权登记的中国方案——对《数据产权登记工作指引（试行）》的解读
titleEn: China's Approach to Data Property Rights Registration: An Interpretation of the Trial Guidelines
sumZh: 北京大学法学院教授常鹏翱解读《指引》，指出其构建了登记机构社会化市场化、登记对象全面、合理审慎审查、登记凭证证明力、登记制度体系化五大维度的中国方案，为全国一体化数据市场提供制度支撑。
sumEn: Peking University law professor Chang Peng'ao interprets the Guidelines as building a Chinese scheme across five dimensions including market-based registration institutions and prudent review, underpinning a unified national data market.

srcZh: 数字中国建设峰会（南方+客户端）
titleZh: 以数据产权登记深化数据要素市场化配置改革
titleEn: Deepening Market-Based Allocation Reform of Data Elements Through Property Rights Registration
sumZh: 广州市政务服务和数据管理局局长黄津解读《指引》，从择优遴选登记机构、明晰登记流程、树立典型应用场景三方面阐述，并结合广州数据交易所累计完成近4500项合规审核、发放近700张凭证的实践提出建议。
sumEn: Guangzhou's data bureau head Huang Jin interprets the Guidelines on registration institutions, procedures and application scenarios, drawing on Guangzhou Data Exchange's practice of over 4,500 compliance reviews and nearly 700 certificates.

srcZh: 数字中国建设峰会（国家数据局）
titleZh: 建立数据产权登记制度 夯实数据基础制度基石
titleEn: Establishing a Data Property Rights Registration System to Consolidate Data Foundations
sumZh: 安徽省数据资源管理局局长王爱学解读《指引》对健全数据基础制度具有引领性制度意义与立标定规的实践意义，并介绍安徽发布数据合规服务智能体、创新“数据产权即服务”模式等探路经验。
sumEn: Anhui data bureau head Wang Aixue interprets the Guidelines as holding leading institutional significance and standardization value, showcasing Anhui's data compliance agent and 'data property as a service' model.

srcZh: 国家发展和改革委员会
titleZh: 建设开放共享安全的全国一体化数据市场
titleEn: Building an Open, Shared and Secure National Integrated Data Market
sumZh: 国家信息中心单志广、赵文景撰文，提出全国一体化数据市场需突出开放、共享、安全三大核心要求，破解场内外“两个市场”协同、多层次交易场所建构、流通服务机构分工协作、安全合规基础设施四大关键问题。
sumEn: Shan Zhiguang and Zhao Wenjing argue the national integrated data market must highlight openness, sharing and security, addressing four key issues including dual-market coordination and multi-tier trading venues.

titleZh: 2026全球数字经济大会知识产权专题论坛举办
titleEn: IP Thematic Forum Held at the 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference
sumZh: 以“知识产权赋能新质生产力发展”为主题的论坛上，最高检副检察长史卫忠呼吁加强对人工智能、具身智能、数据知识产权等前沿问题的研究指导，国家知识产权局副局长胡文辉介绍构建数据知识产权保护规则、搭建全国统一登记平台等举措。
sumEn: At the forum themed 'IP Empowering New Quality Productive Forces', officials called for strengthened guidance on AI, embodied intelligence and data IP, while CNIPA highlighted building data IP protection rules and a unified registration platform.

titleZh: 数字无界跨山海 开放共生向未来
titleEn: Boundless Digital Connectivity: Toward an Open and Symbiotic Future
sumZh: 聚焦2026全球数字经济大会，报道国家知识产权局完善制度体系、构建数据知识产权保护规则、布局137家知识产权保护中心赋能数字经济，并援引高锐“知识产权应是数字经济助推器、制度体系需完成数字化重塑”的观点。
sumEn: Covering the 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference, the piece reports CNIPA's efforts to build data IP rules and 137 IP protection centers, citing Francis Gurry's view that IP should be a digital economy enabler requiring digital reshaping.

srcEn: Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications (Sohu)
titleZh: 以构建数据知识产权制度护航新质生产力发展
titleEn: Building a Data IP System to Safeguard New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 文章提出数据知识产权通过确权、流通共享与价值转化三重机制重构生产要素组合方式，应以“三权分置”为底座，以确权登记、技术赋能、场景驱动为现实路径，激活数据要素潜能发展新质生产力。
sumEn: The piece argues data IP restructures factor combinations through rights confirmation, circulation and value conversion, anchored on the three-rights separation and driven by registration, technology and scenarios.

titleZh: 筑牢数据产权基石 激活要素价值潜能
titleEn: Consolidating the Cornerstone of Data Property Rights to Unleash Value Potential
sumZh: 北京数据集团副总经理、北京国际大数据交易所董事李振军解读数据产权制度，提出以促进流通和激励创新为导向，通过分类施策破解采集生成、融合利用、创新使用三大场景的产权流转难题。
sumEn: Li Zhenjun of Beijing Data Group interprets the data property system as circulation- and innovation-oriented, resolving rights circulation challenges in collection, fusion and innovative-use scenarios through differentiated policies.

srcEn: Xi'an Jiaotong University School of Law
titleZh: 构建支撑数据要素“双循环”的知识产权保护规则
titleEn: Building IP Protection Rules Supporting the Dual Circulation of Data Elements
sumZh: 焦和平教授主张以衍生数据为基准明确数据知识产权客体范围、以版权赋权路径契合衍生数据特性，通过统一登记规则、采取登记对抗主义、对标CPTPP与DEPA等高标准国际规则，支撑数据要素国内国际双循环。
sumEn: Professor Jiao Heping advocates defining data IP objects based on derivative data and a copyright-style path, unifying registration rules and aligning with CPTPP/DEPA standards to support domestic and international data circulation.

titleZh: 以知识产权助推新质生产力发展
titleEn: Using Intellectual Property to Boost New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 清华大学法学院助理研究员徐雨微撰文，提出知识产权一头连着创新、一头连着市场，是新质生产力催化剂，需加快数字经济、人工智能等新兴领域立法，完善数据知识产权保护规则与人工智能生成物使用保护规则。
sumEn: Tsinghua researcher Xu Yuwei argues IP links innovation and the market as a catalyst for new quality productive forces, urging faster legislation for the digital economy and AI and improved data IP protection rules.

titleZh: 平台经济反垄断迈入系统化、精细化治理新阶段
titleEn: Platform Economy Anti-Monopoly Enters a New Stage of Systematic and Refined Governance
sumZh: 中国人民大学法学院院长杨东解读《互联网平台反垄断合规指引》，认为其将“事前监管”与“合规治理”深度融合、以风险示例实现算法穿透监管，主张构建针对流量分配与传导机制的专项调整规则。
sumEn: Renmin University law dean Yang Dong interprets the Platform Anti-Monopoly Compliance Guidelines as integrating ex-ante supervision with compliance governance and penetrating algorithmic regulation, proposing dedicated rules for traffic allocation.

titleZh: 从5起判决看清：中国法院对 AI 创作版权的认定逻辑
titleEn: Understanding Chinese Courts' Logic on AI-Generated Works Copyright from Five Judgments
sumZh: 卫新、徐元昊梳理影视报告案、午评案、Ada数字人案、“春风送来了温柔”案、“伴心”案五起判决，揭示中国法院以“人类中心主义”为内核、以“创作过程审查”为重心的AIGC可版权性裁判路径。
sumEn: Wei Xin and Xu Yuanhao review five judgments, revealing Chinese courts' human-centered, creation-process-focused approach to AIGC copyrightability from early caution to global firsts.

srcZh: 检察日报（最高人民检察院）
titleZh: 人工智能生成内容的著作权认定与有限保护
titleEn: Copyright Recognition and Limited Protection of AI-Generated Content
sumZh: 娄底市检察院唐燕撰文提出坚持自然人创作本源主义与实质智力投入判断标准，将AIGC场景分为纯辅助汇编、创意启发、深度参与创作三类，主张遵循“谁投入谁享有”与思想表达二分法的有限保护原则。
sumEn: Tang Yan proposes adhering to natural-person authorship and substantive intellectual input, categorizing AIGC scenarios into three types and applying a limited protection principle of 'who invests, who owns'.

srcZh: 常熟市人民法院（知识产权律师网）
titleZh: 江苏首例、全国第二例AIGC著作权侵权案
titleEn: Jiangsu's First and China's Second AIGC Copyright Infringement Case
sumZh: 常熟市人民法院审结“伴心”案，认定用户修改提示词并借助PS编辑体现独创性选择安排、构成美术作品，但将保护范围限定于平面图而不及立体装置，避免著作权过度保护与权利滥用。
sumEn: Changshu court ruled the 'Banxin' case, recognizing AI-assisted images as works while limiting protection to the flat image, not the physical installation, to avoid over-protection.

titleZh: 2025年度涉人工智能司法案例盘点
titleEn: Review of 2025 Artificial Intelligence Judicial Cases
sumZh: 中国社会科学院大学刘晓春、童典乐从著作权、人格权、AI幻觉责任、不正当竞争、刑法规制五类梳理2025年代表性AI案例，归纳出独创性个案认定、帮助侵权分层、过错归责等裁判规则与治理趋势。
sumEn: Liu Xiaochun and Tong Dianle review 2025 AI cases across five categories, distilling rules on case-specific originality, layered contributory liability and fault-based attribution.

titleZh: 杭州中院宣判一起涉生成式人工智能服务著作权侵权及不正当竞争纠纷案
titleEn: Hangzhou Intermediate Court Rules on GenAI Service Copyright and Unfair Competition Dispute
sumZh: 杭州中院二审认定针对特定平台场景提供生成式AI服务的应用层服务者应尊重平台规则、履行相应注意义务，从服务性质、场景指向、诱导性、营利性四方面审查，判定AI写作工具服务构成不正当竞争。
sumEn: Hangzhou Intermediate Court held that application-layer GenAI services targeting specific platforms must respect platform rules and bear due diligence, finding the AI writing tool constituted unfair competition.

titleZh: 人工智能生成内容的著作权法定性
titleEn: The Copyright Characterization of AI-Generated Content
sumZh: 深圳知识产权法庭祝建军认为，用户输入提示词属思想范畴、AI输出内容属表达范畴，二者相分离，用户对表达无独创性贡献，人工智能生成内容不应被认定为作品受著作权法保护，可循反不正当竞争法或民法典救济。
sumEn: Justice Zhu Jianjun argues prompts are ideas while AI output is expression, so AIGC should not be protected as works; relief may be sought via anti-unfair competition law or the Civil Code.

titleZh: 新指南新在哪？平台反垄断新指南发布：AI定价、生态封禁等八大场景划出合规红线
titleEn: What's New in the Platform Anti-Monopoly Guidelines: Eight Scenarios Draw Compliance Red Lines
sumZh: 解读《互联网平台反垄断合规指南（征求意见稿）》与《价格规则》协同分层，指出其实现从行为到生态、从现象到算法的升级，聚焦AI定价杀熟、生态封禁、“二选一”、全网最低价等八大风险场景。
sumEn: Interpreting the draft Platform Anti-Monopoly Compliance Guidelines, the piece highlights its upgrade to ecosystem-level and algorithm-penetrating regulation, targeting eight risk scenarios including AI pricing and ecosystem blocking.

srcZh: 经济参考报（中国经济网）
titleZh: 互联网平台反垄断合规指引征求意见
titleEn: Internet Platform Anti-Monopoly Compliance Guidelines Open for Comment
sumZh: 市场监管总局发布《互联网平台反垄断合规指引（征求意见稿）》，以示例列举平台间算法共谋、封禁屏蔽、“二选一”、全网最低价、差别待遇等8种风险，引导平台加强规则审查与算法筛查。
sumEn: SAMR released draft guidelines listing eight risks including algorithmic collusion, blocking and differential treatment via examples, guiding platforms to strengthen rule review and algorithm screening.

titleZh: 让人工智能技术更好造福人类社会
titleEn: Making AI Technology Better Serve Human Society
sumZh: 中国社科院王俊生撰文阐释习近平主席提出的全球人工智能治理4点意见，梳理中国推进大模型开源共享、出台全球首部生成式AI管理办法、成立世界人工智能合作组织等实践，主张坚持联合国核心作用。
sumEn: Wang Junsheng interprets the four proposals on global AI governance, reviewing China's open-source sharing, first GenAI regulations and the World AI Cooperation Organization, and upholding the UN's core role.

titleZh: 夯实人工智能发展的制度保障
titleEn: Consolidating Institutional Safeguards for AI Development
sumZh: 商务部研究院田原撰文，提出完善全链条制度规范、强化知识产权保护、构建安全治理体系、筑牢科技伦理防线四方面举措，明确训练数据、算法模型、AI生成内容等新型知识产权权属与侵权判定标准。
sumEn: Tian Yuan proposes four measures including full-chain institutional norms and strengthened IP protection, clarifying ownership and infringement standards for training data, algorithm models and AI-generated content.

titleZh: 深化市场化配置改革 释放数据要素价值
titleEn: Deepening Market-Based Allocation Reform to Release the Value of Data Elements
sumZh: 国家数据局局长刘烈宏在人民日报撰文，阐述准确把握数据要素市场化和价值化关系、流通交易多元形态与价值释放规律，介绍“531”工作体系，强调以数据赋能人工智能创新发展为重点。
sumEn: National Data Administration head Liu Liehong explains the relationship between marketization and value realization of data, the '531' framework, and prioritizes data-enabled AI innovation.

titleZh: 数据要素驱动下的数字中国发展路径和未来图景
titleEn: Digital China's Development Path and Future Vision Driven by Data Elements
sumZh: 第十二届全国政协副主席王钦敏系统回顾数字中国十年成就，指出数据供给梗阻、流通堵点、生态协同短板三大不足，提出深化制度创新激活数据潜能、强化全域统筹与深度融合赋能等路径。
sumEn: Wang Qinmin reviews a decade of Digital China achievements, flags data supply, circulation and ecosystem shortfalls, and proposes institutional innovation and integrated empowerment pathways.

titleZh: 在生成式人工智能时代应对版权问题：欧盟、法国和英国的最新进展与应对路径
titleEn: Addressing Copyright in the GenAI Era: Latest Developments in the EU, France and the UK
sumZh: IPRdaily编译分析欧盟《版权与生成式AI决议》、英国版权与AI报告及法国法案，指出欧盟趋向强制性透明与权利人中心路径，英国采取证据导向的观望立场，法国引入可反驳的使用推定，形成碎片化的多法域合规拼图。
sumEn: IPRdaily compares the EU's mandatory transparency approach, the UK's evidence-gathering stance and France's rebuttable-use presumption, depicting a fragmented multi-jurisdiction compliance puzzle.

titleZh: 跨境融合视角下知识产权与人工智能治理的协同路径——对话宾夕法尼亚州立大学Daryl Lim教授
titleEn: Coordinating IP and AI Governance from a Cross-Border Perspective: Dialogue with Professor Daryl Lim
sumZh: IPR Daily专访Daryl Lim教授，围绕负责任人工智能的制度构建（以正义、公平与法治为三大支柱）、知识产权与反垄断的动态平衡、发展中国家参与全球IP规则路径等议题展开对话。
sumEn: IPR Daily interviews Professor Daryl Lim on institutionalizing responsible AI, the dynamic balance between IP and antitrust, and developing countries' paths into global IP rules.

titleZh: AI技术的知识产权保护
titleEn: IP Protection for AI Technology
sumZh: 胡世琪系统探讨AIGC著作权权属、AI平台过错责任、训练数据侵权界定及各国立法，主张明确AI生成物作品属性、规范训练数据使用规则、细化算法专利申请审查，形成“司法判例引导—立法细化—技术支撑”治理体系。
sumEn: Hu Shiqi examines AIGC ownership, platform fault liability and training-data infringement, advocating clarified work attributes, regulated training-data use and refined algorithm patent examination.

srcZh: 知识产权律师网（《政法论坛》）
srcEn: IP Lawyer Network (Tribune of Political Science and Law)
titleZh: 互联网平台算法推荐的版权侵权责任研究
titleEn: Research on Copyright Infringement Liability of Internet Platform Algorithmic Recommendation
sumZh: 上海市高级人民法院徐俊提出以平台责任法律逻辑为大前提、算法推荐技术逻辑为小前提的场景化三段论分析，主张算法纯粹输出场景平台无需概括注意义务，而算法流量倾斜场景应承担更高注意义务。
sumEn: Xu Jun of the Shanghai High Court proposes a scenario-based syllogism, holding platforms bear no blanket duty in pure algorithm output but higher duty in algorithm-driven traffic tilting scenarios.

srcZh: 最高人民法院知识产权法庭（《数字法治》）
srcEn: SPC Intellectual Property Court (Digital Rule of Law)
titleZh: 人机共生背景下AIGC可版权性的司法判定——以人类控制性标准与人类贡献为中心
titleEn: Judicial Determination of AIGC Copyrightability in Human-Machine Symbiosis: Human Control and Human Contribution
sumZh: 厦门大学董慧娟教授主张摒弃“绝对控制论”、采纳“有限控制”标准，只要能证明对最终成果中个性化表达要素施加实质性控制并形成可识别的人类贡献，即可获得有限版权保护，举证责任原则上由主张版权者承担。
sumEn: Professor Dong Huijuan advocates abandoning absolute-control theory for a limited-control standard: provable substantive control over personalized expression yields limited copyright, with the burden on the claimant.

srcZh: 北京市京师（郑州）律师事务所（搜狐）
titleZh: AI生成内容版权归属的司法认定、责任边界与合规指引
titleEn: Judicial Determination, Liability Boundaries and Compliance Guidance for AI-Generated Content Copyright
sumZh: 文章基于2026年司法实践，指出“人类独创性智力投入”是AI生成内容构成作品的唯一标准，权利归属遵循“创作人优先、合同约定补充”，并分层界定使用者、平台、开发者的侵权责任，给出留痕固证等合规建议。
sumEn: Based on 2026 jurisprudence, the piece states human originality is the sole test for works, ownership follows creator-first with contractual supplements, and layers liability among users, platforms and developers.

titleZh: 生成式AI与知识产权系列（一）AIGC可版权性和著作权权属问题
titleEn: GenAI and IP Series (I): AIGC Copyrightability and Ownership
sumZh: 李占科、张晓荣梳理多地法院AIGC判例及美日等域外规则，认为国内外主流法域均认可AIGC可版权性但以自然人实质性贡献为前提，指出权属主要取决于AI产品用户协议约定，建议保留创作过程记录以备举证。
sumEn: Li Zhanke and Zhang Xiaorong review Chinese and foreign AIGC cases, concluding copyrightability requires substantial human contribution and ownership hinges on user agreements, advising retention of creation records.

titleZh: 人工智能生成内容的可版权性及其权利归属
titleEn: Copyrightability and Ownership of AI-Generated Content
sumZh: 冯晓青撰文认为AI生成内容符合“智力成果”与“独创性”要件，主张排除AI模型及设计者、投资者、平台作为版权主体，用户因输入富有个性化特征的提示词而成为最合理的版权主体。
sumEn: Feng Xiaoqing argues AIGC satisfies originality and intellectual achievement requirements, excluding AI models, designers and platforms as rightsholders and favoring the user who inputs personalized prompts.

srcZh: 己任律师事务所（腾讯新闻）
titleZh: AI生成内容侵权，平台方要承担何种责任？——中外近期案例对比解读
titleEn: What Liability Do Platforms Bear for AI-Generated Content Infringement? A Comparison of Recent Cases
sumZh: 张佳欣、董雪对比德国GEMA诉OpenAI案、英国Getty诉Stability AI案与中国“美杜莎”“奥特曼”案，归纳出输入端训练数据从宽、输出端生成传播从严的平衡立场及平台过错分层认定逻辑。
sumEn: Zhang Jiaxin and Dong Xue compare German, British and Chinese cases, distilling a balance of leniency on training data and strictness on output distribution, with layered platform fault determination.

titleZh: 一文详解DeepSeek等大模型AI生成内容相关著作权法律问题及案例
titleEn: A Detailed Analysis of Copyright Issues and Cases on AI-Generated Content from DeepSeek and Other LLMs
sumZh: 李嘉颖、徐荣元结合用户协议、判例与法理分析，认为AI输出具有随机性、用户难以控制表达性元素，主张坚守人类作者中心主义，并归纳投喂版权作品、后续编辑、作为作品一部分三类可受保护的AI作品。
sumEn: Li Jiaying and Xu Rongyuan argue AI output is random and beyond user control, uphold human authorship, and identify three protectable categories: copyright-input feeding, subsequent editing and AI content as part of a work.

srcZh: 数字中国建设峰会（国家数据局）
titleZh: 筑牢数据产权制度基石 护航数据要素价值释放
titleEn: Consolidating Data Property Rights as the Cornerstone to Protect Data Value Release
sumZh: 国家发改委创新驱动发展中心霍福鹏、杜万里阐述数据产权制度应把握以流通利用为导向、激励与约束相辅相成、为新业态留足空间三个原则，提出统一登记、司法运用、技术赋能三项重点任务。
sumEn: Huo Fupeng and Du Wanli explain three principles for the data property system and three key tasks: unified registration, judicial application and technology empowerment.

srcZh: 贵州省大数据发展管理局
titleZh: 从产业实践看数据产权改革的落地路径与时代价值
titleEn: Implementation Paths and Value of Data Property Rights Reform from Industrial Practice
sumZh: 陶政坪以贵州实践为样本，提出以“数据工厂”标准化生产与“数据要素评测”质量化管理为两大抓手，形成“产权登记筑基—数据工厂增效—质量评测赋能”的数据价值化全链路。
sumEn: Tao Zhengping uses Guizhou's practice to propose 'data factories' and 'data element evaluation' as two levers, forming a full value chain of registration, factory efficiency and quality assessment.

srcZh: 东方网（上海市人民政府）
titleZh: 上海“政府开放月”聚焦“十五五”：知识产权赋能新质生产力，数据产品领跑“数字新赛道”
titleEn: Shanghai Government Open Month Focuses on the 15th Five-Year Plan: IP Empowers New Productive Forces
sumZh: 报道上海数据产品知识产权登记领跑全国，截至2026年7月底受理申请2245件、发证1592件，已登记数据产品累计实现经济价值约203亿元，24家企业依托数据知产获5.47亿元质押融资。
sumEn: Shanghai leads China in data product IP registration with 2,245 applications and 1,592 certificates by July 2026, generating RMB 20.3 billion in value and RMB 547 million in pledge financing.

titleZh: 如何解决数据资产融资难？数据必须自己“说了算”
titleEn: How to Solve Data Asset Financing Difficulties: Data Must Speak for Itself
sumZh: 报道数据资产质押融资与ABS“齐热”但高度依赖主体信用，指出确权、估值、处置是数据资产从“主体信用”走向“数据信用”必须跨越的三道门槛，距离真正的数据信用仍有距离。
sumEn: Reporting that data asset pledge financing and ABS remain dependent on entity credit, the piece identifies rights confirmation, valuation and disposal as three hurdles toward genuine data credit.

titleZh: 从“知产”到“资产”：2026年知识产权强国建设开启价值落地新篇章
titleEn: From 'IP' to 'Asset': 2026 Opens a New Chapter of Value Realization for IP Power
sumZh: 解读《2026年知识产权强国建设推进计划》七方面106项内容，指出其通过强化信用监管、大力发展知识产权金融、深化协同保护与国际合作，推动知识产权从“软实力”转化为“硬支撑”。
sumEn: Interpreting the 2026 IP Power Promotion Plan's 106 items, it argues credit regulation, IP finance and collaborative protection turn IP from soft power into hard support.

titleZh: 2026年中国数据要素产业政策深度解码与战略展望报告
titleEn: In-Depth Decoding and Strategic Outlook of China's 2026 Data Element Industry Policy
sumZh: 陈志刚解读2026“数据要素价值释放年”，认为改革将由“建设逻辑”进入“运营逻辑”、由“材料叙事”进入“交易叙事”，围绕统一规则、供给侧产品化、AI实效三大通道形成“能力订单”式增量。
sumEn: Chen Zhigang decodes 2026 as the 'data element value release year', arguing the reform shifts from construction to operation logic, with incremental budgets flowing to capability-oriented orders.

srcZh: 中国经济网（中国信息通信研究院）
titleZh: 深化平台经济规律性认识 健全平台反垄断合规指导——《互联网平台反垄断合规指引（征求意见稿）》解读
titleEn: Deepening Understanding of Platform Economy Laws and Improving Anti-Monopoly Compliance Guidance
sumZh: 中国信通院李强治解读《互联网平台反垄断合规指引（征求意见稿）》，认为其基于平台经济生态性、技术性、前瞻性三大特征，系统构建反垄断合规制度体系，为平台预防化解垄断风险提供明确指引。
sumEn: CAICT's Li Qiangzhi interprets the draft guidelines as systematically building an anti-monopoly compliance system based on the ecosystem, technical and forward-looking features of platform economy.

titleZh: 数据要素制度建设引领数据要素潜力加快释放
titleEn: Data Element Institutional Building Leads Accelerated Release of Data Potential
sumZh: 复旦大学黄丽华教授以“供得出、流得动、用得好、保安全”为主线，梳理公共数据“1+3”政策体系、数据基础设施示范工程等成效，指出制度引领数据要素潜力加快释放。
sumEn: Fudan Professor Huang Lihua reviews progress on public data policies and data infrastructure, arguing institutions are leading accelerated release of data element potential.

srcZh: 道可特律师事务所（搜狐）
titleZh: 《数据产权登记工作指引（试行）》深度解读（一）——制度背景与核心框架
titleEn: In-Depth Interpretation of the Trial Data Property Rights Registration Guidelines (I): Background and Core Framework
sumZh: 道可特团队解读《指引》出台背景，指出其确立“统一规则、统一平台、目录准入、全国互认”四位一体架构与“国家统筹、分级负责”治理体制，并剖析登记机构高准入门槛与七步登记闭环。
sumEn: DOCVIT interprets the Guidelines' four-in-one architecture of unified rules, platform, directory access and national recognition, and its high-barrier institutions and seven-step registration loop.

titleZh: 深度解读《数据产权登记工作指引（试行）》
titleEn: In-Depth Interpretation of the Trial Data Property Rights Registration Guidelines
sumZh: 文章解读《指引》核心逻辑是通过登记机制明确数据持有权、使用权、经营权分置结构，提供可验证权利凭证而非创设“数据所有权”，并解析三重审查要点与登记凭证“证明而非设权”的审慎定位。
sumEn: The piece interprets the Guidelines' core logic of clarifying the three separated rights via registration as verifiable proof rather than creating 'data ownership', analyzing the three review points and proof-based positioning.

titleZh: 数据要素价值实现的全链条产权激励
titleEn: Full-Chain Property Rights Incentives for Realizing Data Element Value
sumZh: 吉林大学蔡立东教授提出以数据产权激发数据源头活水、促进融合利用、畅通流动渠道、筑牢安全闸门，通过统一登记体系、示范合同与安全责任机制实现数据要素全链条价值释放。
sumEn: Professor Cai Lidong proposes using data property rights to stimulate data supply, fusion, circulation and security, realizing full-chain value release through unified registration, model contracts and safety mechanisms.

srcZh: 道可特律师事务所（搜狐）
titleZh: 在 AI 时代高科技企业知识产权保护的法律路径优化
titleEn: Optimizing Legal Paths for IP Protection of High-Tech Enterprises in the AI Era
sumZh: 道可特团队剖析2025年AI知识产权裁判密集期趋势，涵盖AIGC可版权性从肯定到审慎、平台“避风港”规则突破重构、模型结构与参数的竞争法保护等，提出“合规前置、动态防御、全球协同、生态整合”四位一体框架。
sumEn: DOCVIT analyzes 2025 AI IP jurisprudence trends and proposes a four-in-one framework of front-loaded compliance, dynamic defense, global coordination and ecosystem integration.

titleZh: 共话AI时代知识产权保护与创新生态
titleEn: Discussing IP Protection and Innovation Ecosystem in the AI Era
sumZh: 报道2025中国知识产权保护高层论坛分论坛三，聚焦AI时代知识产权保护，国家知识产权局介绍完善审查标准、发布AI专利申请指引，清华大学沈阳提出“AI时代选择即创新”观点及版权归属、风格保护等挑战。
sumEn: Covering the 2025 IP Protection High-Level Forum, it reports CNIPA's improved examination standards and AI patent guidelines, and Shen Yang's view that 'in the AI era, selection is innovation'.

titleZh: 2025年《专利审查指南》修改内容解读
titleEn: Interpretation of the 2025 Amendments to the Patent Examination Guidelines
sumZh: 国家知识产权局解读2025年11月发布的《专利审查指南》修改决定，聚焦健全人工智能、比特流、生物育种等新领域新业态专利审查规则，优化“同日双申”、创造性评判等标准。
sumEn: CNIPA interprets the 2025 Patent Examination Guidelines amendments, focusing on improving examination rules for AI, bitstream and breeding, and optimizing double-filing and inventiveness standards.

titleZh: 从确权到分配，国家数据产权制度解读
titleEn: From Rights Confirmation to Distribution: Interpreting the National Data Property Rights System
sumZh: 赛博研究院卢虹羽系统梳理数据产权“三权分置”内容、权益归属与重点场景，解析自动化收集公开数据、多源融合、衍生数据、公共数据授权运营四类场景规则，并对比数据产权与数据产品知识产权登记。
sumEn: Lu Hongyu of Cyber Research Institute organizes the three-rights separation, ownership and key scenarios, analyzing public-data crawling, fusion, derivative data and public-data authorized operation rules.

titleZh: 数据知识产权，是“数据确权”吗？（三）
titleEn: Is Data IP the Same as 'Data Rights Confirmation'? (III)
sumZh: 文章认为数据知识产权登记的功能是对数据集合智力成果的可信记录与公示，不能泛化为通用确权工具，主张数据确权制度与数据知识产权登记制度构成数据基础制度中并列的“双支柱”。
sumEn: The piece argues data IP registration serves as trusted recording of intellectual achievements rather than a universal ownership tool, proposing data rights confirmation and data IP registration as twin pillars.
